entities.summary: Vayu (वायु), also known as Wayu or Hayu (हायु) is a Sino-Tibetan language spoken in Nepal by about 1,520 people in Bagmati Province. Dialects include Pali Gau, Mudajor, Sukajor, Ramechhap, Sindhuli, and Marin Khola.
